LOW.description: Stable note, medication taken as scheduled or only minor uncertainty, no safety signal.
LOW.example_action: Self-monitor, continue routine reminders, ask one clarifying question if useful.

MODERATE.description: Mild worsening, one missed dose, sleep disruption, mild side effect, or caregiver concern without immediate danger.
MODERATE.example_action: Caregiver check-in and routine clinician follow-up if repeated.

HIGH.description: Repeated missed doses, major sleep change, agitation/confusion, concerning side effects, or functional decline.
HIGH.example_action: Same-day or near-term clinician follow-up, caregiver visibility, review med plan.

CRISIS.description: Imminent self-harm/violence/overdose risk, severe confusion, medication misuse risk, or inability to stay safe.
CRISIS.example_action: Emergency/crisis escalation, contact caregiver/emergency services, do not rely on app-only support.
